expectations.text: The deck establishes what the architecture change was before leaning on why it mattered.
expectations.evidence: Slide 4 (what the monolith looked like) precedes slide 5 (the cost/why: 40min deploys, 2 outages/mo) within the Problem section; slide 10 (what: six services) precedes the Results KPI slides.

expectations.text: Deploy time and outage-reduction KPIs are presented with a takeaway each.
expectations.evidence: Slide 5 and slide 16 both use the kpi layout (40min/2-outages and 6min/0-outages respectively) with explanatory takeaway text, plus a dedicated before/after slide 17.

expectations.text: The deck is noticeably more detailed, with the deepest detail in speaker notes rather than cluttering visible slides, per the user's explicit request.
expectations.evidence: 20 slides, with per-slide notes ranging 290-1028 characters (e.g. slide 18 trade-offs note is 1028 chars) holding the heaviest detail, while visible slide text stays in short bullets.

expectations.text: The deck is understandable to engineers who weren't involved, without assumed shared knowledge.
expectations.evidence: Slide 2 explicitly states 'Most of you weren't in the room for this decision - this deck is the room,' and slide 9 explains the event-vs-direct-call rationale from first principles.
